addition.item: Let AI assistants such as Claude Code or Codex read your forms through a read-only MCP endpoint of the Joomla API, with a user's API token and that user's permissions. It is off by default: turn it on with "Enable MCP" in the options. The Configuration page shows whether it is enabled.

Choose what to import from a package file: its items are listed by kind with their status (new, replaced or identical), identical items are left untouched, and the confirmation says what will be written.
See what an import wrote: the forms, scripts, pieces, menu items, Integrator rules and template files, each with a link. Items about to be replaced link to the existing one.
Import packages exported as XML by BreezingForms or FacileForms. The accepted formats are shown on the import screen, and the Import button stays disabled until a file is chosen.

Export and import the custom email and PDF templates of forms, and their Integrator rules, in a package. Templates need the Configure permission and rules the code permission; without it they are left out with a warning and the rest of the package is imported.
Record imports, copies and restores in a form's history, with a version note and the version of origin.

change.item: Package files hold the QuickMode template code of forms as readable text. Files exported by earlier versions are still imported.
Show clearer import errors naming the file, the upload size and JSON problems, tooltips on the export fields, and the package name in the package list of a form.

The standard database pieces (ff_query, ff_select, ff_selectValue and ff_databaseToSelect) use the Joomla database directly and no longer need the BreezingForms compatibility plugin. Updates keep any piece you customised.
Use the word element in the Stripe amount help and capitalize the QuickMode add buttons in all eight languages.
Update the bundled Stripe and PDF libraries.
Remove the last Adobe Flash file from the package. Updates delete it from existing sites.

fix.item: Fix the standard piece ff_databaseToSelect, whose code had a syntax error.
Export every form column, including the admin and user email settings, and refuse forms, scripts and pieces without a name or sharing one instead of silently keeping only one of them.
Export a package without having to check both the template and the Integrator switches.
Keep the elements of an imported form in their original order and keep the selection made in the import tables.
Keep the Integrator rules of a replaced form on its new elements, and report the rules left without their element.
Do not let a package overwrite the template files of a form of another package. The import says which forms were left out.
Refuse a package whose forms have a missing, shared or invalid id, so that templates and Integrator rules cannot reach another form.
Copy a form whose elements hold empty (NULL) columns.
Translate the captcha refresh button and the double opt-in email subject where they were wrong or still in English.
Remove PHP 8.5 deprecation notices raised when resizing uploaded images.
Report form errors and upload errors together when importing records, with clearer upload size and extension messages.

security.item: Generate upload tickets, stored upload names, payment cache files and export file names from a cryptographically secure random source. They were predictable, and payment cache files sit in the public media folder.
Answer the upload callback in plain text, so that browsers never interpret an uploaded file name as HTML.
Require the code permission to export or import Integrator rules, and show names from an imported file as plain text in the confirmation.

addition.item: Search form scripts and form or submit pieces from QuickMode Options while Debug is enabled, including saved custom code and edits in the code editor.

change.item: Turn off a form's Debug mode when opening or closing QuickMode, while keeping it available through a Save reload.
Show active Debug with the same red badge and white bug icon used by ContentBuilder.

addition.item: Search form elements by text or property value in the QuickMode editor while Debug is enabled.
Choose a BreezingForms page number or an external URL as the Stripe return destination.

change.item: New Stripe elements use an amount from a form element by default.
Improve contrast on selected administrator tabs and spacing around element script controls.

fix.item: Show active Stripe and email notification choices clearly, keep them readable on hover, and show the element label in form search results.
Avoid an unsaved changes warning when browsing QuickMode elements and tabs without editing.
Increase spacing between validation choices in the element editor.
Warn before leaving QuickMode with a newly added element or other unsaved changes.
Detect edits to element properties and Stripe settings in the unsaved changes warning.
Keep the unsaved changes warning active after direct edits to any QuickMode element field.
Keep the email editor toolbar visible when BreezingForms enters full page mode.
Restore the None, Library and Custom selectors for scripts and pieces in QuickMode Options.

change.item: Reduce the installer download size by excluding unused CAPTCHA background-noise recordings. Installation and updates also remove these recordings left by earlier versions. Image CAPTCHA, XLSX exports and the About Piranha animation remain available.

fix.item: Start Stripe and PayPal payments without an action script, for both fixed amounts and amounts from a field.
Show Stripe instead of PayPal on a classic-layout Stripe button without an image.

addition.item: Show an Unsaved changes badge in the script editor, and warn before leaving the page with unsaved changes.

change.item: Take the number of pages of a QuickMode form from its tree: a value typed in the Pages field of the Options tab is ignored, and a wrong number is corrected at the next save.

fix.item: Show the messages of a QuickMode save on the page. A failed save of the options looked like a success: the page now shows the error, stays open and lets you save again.
Keep the notification recipient and the thank-you page script changed in the QuickMode tree, instead of putting back their old values.

addition.item: Click the Piranha logo five times on the About page to play its animation. The final frame stays visible until you close it with X or Escape; opening it again restarts playback.

change.item: Remove the unavailable administrator form display, its Run Mode option and the Sync to Joomla Menu button. The update removes administrator menu entries that opened empty pages.

Forms previously saved as Backend only are unpublished during updates and package imports to keep them off the site. Publish them explicitly to make them available. Imports warn about each affected form, show its previous publication state and record the change in the log.

fix.item: Display forms saved as Frontend & Backend through modules and article plugins instead of reporting that the form was not found.
Keep a form's display mode unchanged when restoring a saved version.
Remove obsolete administrator links from form error reports.
Preserve component settings and correctly register the installed version when upgrading a legacy BreezingForms installation.

addition.item: Let the amount of the Stripe element come from a form field, and refuse the form when the field holds no valid amount.
Show the email body and template settings in the Administrator Notification tab.
Group the Stripe element settings in sections, with masked keys, the test or production mode, and automatic or manual payment methods.

change.item: Use the browser tooltips of the title attributes in the administration, as the Joomla article list does.
Use EUR by default for the Stripe element, and rename iDEAL | Wero to Wero.

fix.item: Keep a setting that a form options screen does not send, instead of resetting it on save.
Complete QuickMode saves on forms with old elements when the site displays PHP notices: options, version and reload were lost.
Reload the page after each QuickMode save, so the title shows the new version number.
Keep the rich text editors working while the QuickMode Options tab is saved.
Show a clear save message with its icon.
Load the QuickMode tree script with its version, so a browser cannot keep an old copy after an update.

addition.item: Show the email body of the user confirmation: a preview of the default email, or the template editor with its field variables.
List what is attached to a package before dissolving it, and warn that a later import creates duplicates.
Add one icon and one color per field type, grouped by family, in the QuickMode menu and tree.

change.item: Let the Stripe Dashboard set the payment methods: card must be enabled there, and other enabled methods can appear on the payment page.
Rename Create Package to Create or edit package, its download button to Export package, and move Delete package to the Configuration screen as Dissolve package.
Choose the package of a form from a list of existing packages.
Hide the Viewed and Exported columns of the records list by default.
Show the QuickMode Options tab on the form root only, and add a tooltip to every label of the form options.
Use paquet instead of package in the French interface.

fix.item: Open the Stripe payment page again: Stripe now refuses payment_method_types.
Restore the settings of the User Confirmation tab, which each save reset, custom template included.
Repair the Edit modals of the QuickMode page and section texts.
Keep the code edited in scripts and pieces when saving on the classic form screen.
Share the width between the QuickMode tree and panel on narrow screens.
Repair the Keep panel docked and Scroll element list settings of QuickMode.
Show the arrow of the back to top button.

addition.item: Offer Klarna and iDEAL | Wero on the Stripe Checkout page, as options of the Stripe element.
Record Stripe payments from a signed webhook, even when the customer does not come back to the site.
Write the component warnings and errors to administrator/logs/com_breezingformsng.php.

remove.item: Remove the Sofort element, discontinued by Klarna: stored Sofort elements are no longer shown, and QuickMode drops them when the form is opened.

fix.item: Show a payment error instead of a fatal error when Stripe cannot open the payment page.
Check that a Stripe session belongs to the record it confirms, and record a payment only once.
Refuse submissions of a form whose only payment was Sofort until another payment is set up, instead of accepting them unpaid.
Unpublish a form whose only payment was Sofort when QuickMode saves it without Stripe or PayPal, instead of making it free.
Restore the code framework buttons of the QuickMode custom scripts and keep the alert setting on the next-page check.
Remove the output buffer notice after a form submission.
Display a form page without an active menu item, and keep stored QuickMode forms intact when the update cannot rewrite their old links.
Repair migration of legacy BreezingForms installations, including menu links, component registration, and stored record dates.
Keep QuickMode checkbox changes when saving properties and close its editor dialog after saving.
Correct QuickMode form submission and summary display issues.

addition.item: Keep and restore version history for forms, scripts, and pieces.
Show record audit information and allow active, archived, viewed, and exported states to be changed directly.
Integrate with Joomla privacy requests to export or remove personal data from form records.

change.item: Use Joomla administration lists, search tools, and pagination for forms, menus, records, scripts, pieces, and integrator rules.
Use ContentBuilder NG services for linked forms and records.
Provide a dedicated Joomla form for CSV record imports.
Upgrade the QuickMode editor tree to jsTree 3 while keeping existing form data.

fix.item: Add the columns BreezingForms NG needs when it is installed over existing BreezingForms Pro tables. Records, Forms, Scripts and Pieces no longer fail with "Unknown column" errors.
Remove the "Database update version does not match" warning shown for BreezingForms NG in Joomla's database maintenance screen.
Keep each plugin's enabled or disabled state on install and update instead of enabling all plugins again.
Stop re-applying unchanged column definitions on every update.
Display script descriptions containing HTML characters correctly in the script editor.
Fix untranslated text in the audit report and after copying scripts or pieces with nothing selected.

addition.item: The audit now reports table columns that are missing and forms left with debug mode enabled.
Pieces and scripts can be published or unpublished from their editor with a single click, saved immediately.

change.item: In the piece and script editors, help text now appears when hovering a field label, and the piece description is a resizable text area.
The About screen shows version information first, with a shorter introduction and collapsed library lists.
The audit toolbar button is now labelled "Audit".
